{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import requests, json, os

session = requests.Session()
BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'
results = []
bugs = []

def log(test_id, name, status, details, bug=None):
    r = {'test_id': test_id, 'name': name, 'status': status, 'details': str(details)[:800]}
    results.append(r)
    if bug:
        bugs.append(bug)
    print(f'[{test_id}] {name}: {status} | {str(details)[:300]}')

# Login + CSRF
session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/login', json={'email': 'a', 'password': 'a'})
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/csrf-token')
csrf = r.json().get('csrf_token')
session.headers.update({'X-CSRFToken': csrf})

# ===== T10: Reports list =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/reports/list')
print(f'reports/list: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
log('T10', 'Reports list', 'PASS' if r.status_code == 200 else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')
if r.status_code not in [200, 404]:
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-06', 'severity': 'HIGH', 'title': 'Reports list endpoint error',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/reports/list', 'expected': 'HTTP 200 or 404', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T11: Reports generate valid =====
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/reports/generate', json={'year': 2024})
print(f'reports/generate 2024: {r.status_code} {r.text[:600]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    log('T11', 'Reports generate year=2024', 'PASS', f'HTTP 200 {r.text[:200]}')
elif r.status_code == 500:
    log('T11', 'Reports generate year=2024', 'FAIL', f'HTTP 500 - CRITICAL')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-07', 'severity': 'CRITICAL', 'title': 'Reports generate returns 500',
                 'endpoint': 'POST /api/reports/generate', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP 500 {r.text[:200]}'})
else:
    log('T11', 'Reports generate year=2024', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')
    if r.status_code >= 500:
        bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-07', 'severity': 'CRITICAL', 'title': f'Reports generate returns {r.status_code}',
                     'endpoint': 'POST /api/reports/generate', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T12: Reports generate invalid year =====
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/reports/generate', json={'year': 1800})
print(f'reports/generate year=1800: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code == 400:
    log('T12', 'Reports generate invalid year=1800', 'PASS', f'HTTP 400 (validation works)')
elif r.status_code == 200:
    log('T12', 'Reports generate invalid year=1800', 'FAIL', f'HTTP 200 - no validation of invalid year 1800')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-08', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'Reports generate accepts year=1800 without validation',
                 'endpoint': 'POST /api/reports/generate', 'expected': 'HTTP 400', 'actual': 'HTTP 200'})
else:
    log('T12', 'Reports generate invalid year=1800', 'INFO', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')

# ===== T13: Reports generate empty body =====
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/reports/generate', json={})
print(f'reports/generate empty: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code == 400:
    log('T13', 'Reports generate empty body', 'PASS', f'HTTP 400 (validation works)')
elif r.status_code == 200:
    log('T13', 'Reports generate empty body', 'FAIL', 'HTTP 200 - no validation of empty body')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-09', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'Reports generate accepts empty body without validation',
                 'endpoint': 'POST /api/reports/generate', 'expected': 'HTTP 400', 'actual': 'HTTP 200'})
else:
    log('T13', 'Reports generate empty body', 'INFO', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')

# ===== T14: Reports export =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/reports/export')
print(f'reports/export: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}')
log('T14', 'Reports export', 'PASS' if r.status_code in [200, 400] else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:150]}')

# ===== T15: QAQC dashboard =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/qaqc/dashboard')
print(f'qaqc/dashboard: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    log('T15', 'QAQC dashboard', 'PASS', f'HTTP 200 {r.text[:200]}')
elif r.status_code == 404:
    log('T15', 'QAQC dashboard', 'FAIL', 'HTTP 404 - endpoint not found')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-10', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'QA/QC dashboard endpoint not found (404)',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/qaqc/dashboard', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': 'HTTP 404'})
else:
    log('T15', 'QAQC dashboard', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-10', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': f'QA/QC dashboard returned {r.status_code}',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/qaqc/dashboard', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T16: QAQC summary =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/qaqc/summary')
print(f'qaqc/summary: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}')
log('T16', 'QAQC summary', 'PASS' if r.status_code in [200, 404] else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:150]}')

# ===== T17: POST extreme emission for anomaly detection =====
ANOMALY_ID = None
payload = {'source_type': 'Combustion', 'quantity': 999999999.0, 'unit': 'MMBtu', 'facility_id': 1, 
           'year': 2024, 'month': 1, 'fuel_type': 'Natural Gas', 'sub_type': 'Stationary', 'notes': 'Anomaly test - extremely high'}
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions', json=payload)
print(f'POST extreme emission: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code in [200, 201]:
    data = r.json()
    ANOMALY_ID = data.get('id') or (data.get('record') or {}).get('id') or (data.get('emission') or {}).get('id')
    log('T17', 'POST extreme emission for anomaly', 'PASS', f'ID={ANOMALY_ID}')
else:
    log('T17', 'POST extreme emission for anomaly', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')

# ===== T18: QAQC dashboard after anomaly =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/qaqc/dashboard')
print(f'qaqc/dashboard after anomaly: {r.status_code} {r.text[:600]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    data = r.json()
    txt = json.dumps(data).lower()
    has_anomaly = 'anomal' in txt or 'outlier' in txt or 'flag' in txt or 'high' in txt or 'alert' in txt or len(data if isinstance(data, list) else []) > 0
    log('T18', 'QAQC anomaly detection', 'PASS' if has_anomaly else 'FAIL', f'Anomaly detected: {has_anomaly}, response: {str(data)[:300]}')
    if not has_anomaly:
        bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-11', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'QA/QC anomaly detection not triggered for extreme value (999999999 MMBtu)',
                     'endpoint': 'GET /api/qaqc/dashboard', 'expected': 'anomaly flagged', 'actual': 'no anomaly detected'})
else:
    log('T18', 'QAQC anomaly detection', 'SKIP', f'QAQC endpoint unavailable: HTTP {r.status_code}')

# Cleanup anomaly
if ANOMALY_ID:
    session.delete(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions/{ANOMALY_ID}')
    print(f'Cleaned up anomaly emission {ANOMALY_ID}')

print(json.dumps({'results': results, 'bugs': bugs}, indent=2))
" 2>&1
","Cwd":"C:\Users\samsung\Desktop\H2","WaitMsBeforeAsync":20000,"toolAction":"Running phase 2 tests","toolSummary":"Phase 2 reports and QAQC tests"}
